Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026
Technical, Tradesman, Warrant Officer and Rifleman
Online applications close on 28 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Eligible candidates must apply through the official Assam Rifles website. The recruitment rally is tentatively scheduled from 23 November 2026 onwards. Check post-wise eligibility before applying.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 Cancelled: The Directorate General Assam Rifles has officially cancelled the advertisement for the Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026, which was published on 25 September 2026. The earlier notification invited applications for 354 Group C posts, with the last date for submission being 28 October 2026.
According to the cancellation notice, a fresh advertisement will be published in due course. The online application portal will reopen for one month from the date of publication of the new advertisement. Candidates who paid the Rs 100 application fee under the previous notification will receive a refund to the same account used for payment. Candidates are advised to wait for the fresh notification for updated recruitment details and application dates.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Directorate General Assam Rifles is conducting the Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 for 354 vacancies across 18 technical and tradesman categories. The following table covers the important application, eligibility, vacancy, examination, physical fitness and selection requirements.
Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Assam Rifles opened online applications for Technical and Tradesman posts on 28 September 2026. Eligible candidates must complete the application process by 28 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. The recruitment rally is tentatively scheduled from 23 November 2026 onwards.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Vacancy 2026
The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 notification lists 354 tentative vacancies across 18 trades. Warrant Officer (Cipher) has the highest number of vacancies with 124 posts, followed by Rifleman (Electrical Fitter Signal) with 32 posts.
Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Category-wise Vacancy
The recruitment notification provides separate category-wise vacancy allocations for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Economically Weaker Section and Unreserved candidates. There is no state-wise quota.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Eligibility Criteria 2026
Candidates must meet the educational qualification and age requirements prescribed for their chosen Assam Rifles trade. The notification includes opportunities for candidates with Class 10, Class 12, relevant ITI qualifications, technical diplomas and specified healthcare qualifications.
Assam Rifles Warrant Officer Cipher Qualification 2026
Applicants for Warrant Officer (Cipher) must have passed 10+2 with English and Mathematics from a recognized board, along with the prescribed technical qualification. The notification specifies recognized computer or information technology-related diploma qualifications.
Assam Rifles Technical Trades Qualification
The technical trades include Electrical Fitter Signal, Lineman Field, Armourer, Engineer Equipment Mechanic, Recovery Vehicle Mechanic, Electrician Motor Vehicle, Instrument Mechanic, Metalsmith, Upholster, Store Keeper Technical, Vehicle Mechanic, Welder and Mason.
Educational requirements vary by trade and generally include Matriculation with relevant ITI certification, technical training or a recognized diploma in the prescribed discipline.
Assam Rifles Medical and Healthcare Trades Eligibility
The advertisement also provides vacancies for specialized healthcare positions, including Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist.
Important: Trade-wise educational qualifications, course durations, ITI specializations and age limits are separately prescribed in Appendix A of the official notification. Candidates must verify the exact requirements for their selected trade before applying.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Age Limit 2026
The age limit for Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 varies by trade. Most Rifleman technical posts have an age limit of 18 to 23 years, while certain Warrant Officer posts have a different upper age limit.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Application Fee 2026
The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 application fee is Rs. 100 for candidates required to pay the fee. SC, ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.
Candidates may pay through the online payment facility or the prescribed SBI Bank Challan option. Payment receipts must be retained for verification during the recruitment rally.
Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Selection Process 2026
The Assam Rifles recruitment process consists of several stages to assess physical fitness, technical knowledge, trade skills and medical eligibility.
Review Medical Examination (RME), where applicable.
Candidates qualifying the preliminary physical and document checks will be considered for further stages. The Trade Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Shortlisting is based on CBT merit and the applicable recruitment conditions.
Assam Rifles Physical Efficiency Test 2026
The Physical Efficiency Test requires candidates to complete the prescribed running distance within the qualifying time.
The Physical Standard Test includes height, chest and weight measurements. Relaxed standards apply to eligible candidates from specific regions and tribal categories.
Weight must be proportionate to height and age according to the prescribed medical standards. Candidates claiming a physical standard relaxation must produce the required supporting certificate.
The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Computer Based Test will consist of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks. The examination duration is two hours, and negative marking will apply.
Assam Rifles CBT Minimum Qualifying Marks
The question paper will be based on the Food Safety Officer syllabus prescribed by the recruiting department.
Shortlisted candidates must undergo the Trade Skill Test relevant to their applied post. The test consists of practical assessment of the required technical or vocational skills.
The Trade Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Candidates must pass this stage to remain eligible for further recruitment formalities.
How to Apply Online for Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026
Eligible candidates can submit the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 application online through the official Assam Rifles website by 28 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Visit the official Assam Rifles website at https://www.assamrifles.gov.in/ .
Open the Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 notification.
Read the complete eligibility requirements for the relevant post or trade.
Complete the application with personal, educational, contact and domicile details.
Select the appropriate trade and reservation category.
Complete the prescribed fee payment if applicable.
Review the application carefully before submission.
Submit the application and download the acknowledgement.
Print the completed application form and retain the fee receipt or challan.
Carry the application printout and required original documents when reporting for the recruitment rally.
Important: Candidates may submit only one online application. Requests to change the trade, category or submitted information after final submission will not be accepted.
Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Important Documents
Candidates must possess the required eligibility and identity documents when completing their application and attending the recruitment rally.
Class 10 certificate for date of birth verification.
Relevant educational qualification certificates and mark sheets.
ITI, diploma or technical training certificates, where applicable.
Domicile / Permanent Residential Certificate.
SC, ST, OBC or EWS certificate, where applicable.
Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable.
Application fee payment receipt or SBI challan, where applicable.
